{"id":1926973044,"question_id":4044,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months","timestamp":1771731233,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"106 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1926973044/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Bitwise XOR After Rearrangement","memory":"101.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string maximumXor(string s, string t) {\n        int ones = 0;\n        int zeros = 0;\n\n        for(auto it : t){\n            if(it == '1') ones++;\n            else zeros++;\n        } \n\n        string formation = \"\";\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<s.size() ; i++){\n            if(s[i] == '0')\n            {\n                if(ones > 0) \n                {\n                    formation.push_back(1 + '0');\n                    ones--;\n                }\n                else \n                {\n                    formation.push_back(0 + '0');\n                    zeros--;\n                }\n            }\n            else \n            {\n                if(zeros > 0) \n                {\n                    formation.push_back(0 + '0');\n                    zeros--;\n                }\n                else\n                {\n                    formation.push_back(1 + '0');\n                    ones--;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    string ans = \"\";\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<formation.size() ; i++){\n            if(s[i] == formation[i]) ans.push_back('0');\n            else ans.push_back('1');\n        }\n    return ans;\n        \n    \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-bitwise-xor-after-rearrangement","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1731}
